As Coty (COTY) Market Valuation Declined, Msdc Management LP Has Increased Holding; As Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Stock Price Rose, Segantii Capital Management LTD Upped Position
May 18, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Simon Sadler increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 183.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Segantii Capital Management Ltd bought 27,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Simon Sadler held 42,500 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.33 million, up from 15,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Segantii Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $501.56 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.42% or $0.82 $195.2. About 8.10M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Msdc Management Lp increased its stake in Coty Inc (COTY) by 21.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Msdc Management Lp bought 1.24M shares as the company’s stock declined 8.23% with the market. The hedge fund held 7.14 million shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $142.09 million, up from 5.90M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Msdc Management Lp who had been investing in Coty Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $10.49B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.45% or $0.205 $13.975. About 5.10 million shares traded or 0.45% up from the average. Coty Inc. (NYSE:COTY) has risen 0.16% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.39% the S&P500.
